name: Zemar
overview: Zemar is a male figure identified in Scripture as a son of Canaan, placing him within the genealogical framework descending from Noah's grandson. Beyond this unique attribute, there is no additional tribal affiliation or notable personal details recorded about him in the biblical text.
namesAndTitles: The name 'Zemar' appears as a proper name in Genesis 10:18. No specific meaning or divine origin is attributed to this name in the biblical record, so it is presented plainly without further significance.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Zemar as a son of Canaan, establishing his place within the Canaanite lineage. No other family relationships or descendants are noted for him in the biblical account.
scriptureSignificance: Zemar's significance lies primarily in his genealogical mention as part of the descendants of Canaan, who himself is a son of Ham and grandson of Noah. This connection situates Zemar within the broader narrative of the nations' origins after the Flood, underscoring God's providential ordering of peoples as detailed in Genesis 10. While Zemar himself does not have a notable narrative role, his inclusion affirms the biblical emphasis on lineage and the fulfillment of God's sovereign plan through history.
